_comment: GOLDEN-63, 30 epoch, SH-ON CONTROL — the matched baseline for
_golden63_gps_30ep_slant.json.  Identical to the golden-63 fast arm
(_golden63_gps_1h_laneoff: 61 in-network GPS-only, WTZZ00DEU colocated consumer holdout,
channel_mode single, frequency_mode triple, lane_carry OFF, full golden instrumentation)
with duration cut to 900 s = 30 epochs and its own lineage.
WHY A NEW CONTROL rather than reusing _golden63_gps_1h_laneoff's 2266.8 ms median: that
arm ran 15:03-15:08 while a sibling 305-station job held roughly half the 20-thread box.
Its timing is contention-contaminated and cannot baseline a speed claim.  This arm and
the slant arm run back-to-back on a CLEAN machine, 30 epochs each, so the SH-vs-slant
delta is measured on equal footing.
RUN IT ALONE and grade on D0/D0b section medians over settled epochs, never on wall.
30 epochs is enough for a COST comparison but NOT for any science claim — it is inside
ignition on this lineage, so do not read total_IF, carry retention or AR from it.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY.  Own paths; never resume onto another arm's snapshot.
